PeakAnnotationISF S4 class

Source: R/class_PeakAnnotationISF.R
PeakAnnotationISF-class.Rd

Container for MS2 fragment-based annotation of an MS1 feature table.

Phase 1 — Intra-group MS2 fragment (Tier 1c) For each confirmed parent feature (identified by parent_col == parent_val) with a consensus MS2 spectrum, every other feature in the same library group is checked: if its mzmed matches any fragment ion within ppm_isf and rt_isf_threshold seconds, it receives Tier 1c.

Phase 2 — RT-gated MS2 fragment (Tier 1c_exp) The full feature pool (features not in any Phase 1 group) is searched within rt_isf_threshold seconds of the parent. Matching features receive Tier 1c_exp.

Slots

phase1_result

data.frame. Output of annotate().

ms2_list

list. Named list from read_ms2_consensus().

FT

data.frame. Full MS1 feature pool.

parent_col

character. Column identifying parent features. Default "PI_match".

parent_val

ANY. Value marking a parent. NULL = any non-empty string. Default NULL.

ppm_isf

numeric. ppm tolerance for fragment m/z matching. Default 10.

mz_threshold_isf

numeric. Absolute m/z floor (Da). Default 0.005.

rt_isf_threshold

numeric. RT window (seconds). Default 5.
